dialog.text: Great! You have collected enough Gems in order to start building recource production centers.
Select one of the Centers available from the right by right clicking the buttom and place them on the tiles near you. Use "W, A, S, D" to place the center.
Once you have a recource building you'll start generating recources with each action you take. With these resources, you can build walls, gates, and turrets to protect your base.
Each building has a limit on how much of that resources can have, so in short, the more buildings you have the more resources you can have
